title: Fresh Water
intro: Hi, are you the one staying with the Cruz family? I’m Ana. Since the last typhoon our water keeps cutting out, and last month it came out cloudy for a whole day.
My brother works for the water utility. He says all our drinking water comes from underground, a layer of fresh water floating on salt water, and that it’s easy to ruin and hard to fix.
We’ve got an old septic tank in the yard right on top of it.
I’d like to know what I can actually do.
